li-ning-axforce-90: Fast and snappy with easy clears; some note a small sweet spot that feels blunt off-centre.
li-ning-halbertec-9000: Soft, forgiving feel that is easy to swing, but smash power is limited for hard hitters.
victor-auraspeed-100x-ultra: Fast, agile handling with quick drives and defence; some find it short on smash power.
victor-auraspeed-90k-metallic: Fast, stiff and solid, but many say the very stiff shaft demands good technique.
victor-auraspeed-fantome: Very fast to swing and good in defence, though stiff and demanding enough to tire the forearm.
victor-auraspeed-hs-plus: Very fast with quick defence for doubles; the stiff shaft and compact head make it demanding.
victor-drivex-10-metallic: Head-heavy with easy smash power for hard hitters; stiff and demanding, so technique matters.
victor-drivex-12: Excellent control and stability for mid to back-court doubles, though some find it sluggish.
victor-thruster-f-c-ultra: Effortless power from the head weight and a quick swing for its size; a few mention vibration.
victor-thruster-ryuga-ii-pro: Head-heavy but stable with easy power; some find it slow to swing and stiff.
victor-thruster-ryuga-metallic: Big smash power and stability from a stiff, very head-heavy build; slow in fast doubles defence.
yonex-arcsaber-11-play: Control, quick handling and comfort at a modest price; the main downside is limited smash power.
yonex-arcsaber-11-pro: Outstanding control and shuttle hold for doubles; the main complaint is weak smashes and clears.
yonex-arcsaber-7-pro: Easy, forgiving control that suits doubles; the complaint is a lack of smash power.
yonex-astrox-77-pro: Friendly step into head-heavy rackets with easy power; some find it slow through the air.
yonex-astrox-88-d-pro: Heavy, effortless smashes and clears, though it is slower in drives and tires the shoulder.
yonex-astrox-88-s-pro: Fast handling and sharp front-court doubles play; less back-court smash power hurts it in singles.
yonex-astrox-nextage: Forgiving, with a large sweet spot for the price; a few found it too flexible or lacking net feel.
yonex-nanoflare-1000-z: Fast handling and crisp power, but many report cracked or broken frames, even without a hard clash.
yonex-nanoflare-800-pro: Very fast handling and a forgiving sweet spot; several frames broke and some find smashes weak.
